messages.author: AndyTheHusky
messages.text:
Example:

i go to my coalition bank
i withdraw something
i get sent back

Example #2:
i go to my coalition bank to accept requests
i accept one of many
i get sent back

make it stop doing that. i dont think this needs a vote...

messages.author: Affairs and Order
messages.text:
<@1180720719060029500> You were completely right — this was pure UX friction, no vote needed!

**The Fix:**
- Fixed in **PR #213** and deployed live to production.
- All coalition bank routes (personal deposits, withdrawals, leadership balance adjustments, and request approvals/cancellations) now append `#bank` to their redirects.
- Performing transactions or approving requests in bulk now keeps you directly on the Bank tab instead of kicking you back to the General overview screen every time.

Thanks for calling this out!

title: Stop sending me back to a section's "main page"
